habitat: Shallow lakes, deep brackish water, saltpans and coastal lagoons. It filters bottom sediment stirred up by its feet, often with the head submerged.
summary: Newman calls it a locally abundant nomadic resident and a visitor from other parts of Africa. White, with a pink bill tipped black, long pink legs, and red and black wings. It is taller and whiter than Lesser Flamingo. In flight the wing coverts are a uniform scarlet. The immature is grey and black, with a blue-grey bill. Newman does not describe the voice. Status and months are unset. The Kemp code NB was left unchanged.

similar.note: Lesser Flamingo is smaller and pinker, with a dark maroon bill that looks black, not a pink bill tipped black.
